title: New towns are back – but this time they must be more walkable

paragraphs.english: This page is an independently written reading guide to an article published by The Conversation on 21 May 2026. Its authors are James White, Professor of Planning and Urban Design at the University of Glasgow, and Hannah Hickman, Associate Professor in Planning Practice at the University of the West of England. The original is linked at the foot of the page. What follows traces the argument in order and explains the ideas it depends on; it is not a translation, and the wording is our own.
paragraphs.chinese: 本页是为《The Conversation》2026 年 5 月 21 日发表的一篇文章独立撰写的阅读导读。作者是格拉斯哥大学城市规划与设计教授 James White，以及西英格兰大学规划实践副教授 Hannah Hickman。原文链接见页尾。以下按顺序梳理文章论证，并解释它依赖的概念；这不是原文翻译，文字由本站自己撰写。

paragraphs.english: The subject is a policy programme rather than a single study. The UK government has made a new generation of new towns a central part of its growth strategy, and has presented them as a way of addressing the housing shortage at the same time. The article's question is not whether the towns will be built, but whether they will be built in the form that the policy promises.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章讨论的是一项政策计划，而不是某一项研究。英国政府把新一代新城作为增长战略的核心部分，同时把它们说成解决住房短缺的一条途径。文章的问题不是这些城镇会不会建，而是它们会不会以政策所承诺的形态建成。

paragraphs.english: The promised form is a deliberate break with the past. The new towns built after the second world war were low-rise and depended on cars. The proposed ones are meant to be denser, more walkable, and organised around public transport and active travel. That contrast gives the article its frame: the same label, a different model of urban life.
paragraphs.chinese: 承诺的形态是有意与过去决裂。二战后建成的第一批新城是低层的，依赖汽车。而这一次提出的新城意在更紧凑、更宜步行，并以公共交通和主动出行（步行、骑车）来组织。这一对比构成了文章的框架：同一个名称，另一种城市生活模式。

paragraphs.english: The authors then introduce the difficulty immediately, and it is a practical one. The UK, they write, does not build dense housing particularly well, and economic, political and cultural forces are pushing new developments in the opposite direction. The rest of the piece is an account of those forces.
paragraphs.chinese: 作者随即点出难点，而且这是一个实务上的难点。他们写道，英国并不特别擅长建造高密度住宅，而经济、政治与文化力量正把新开发项目推向相反方向。文章的其余部分就是在说明这些力量。

paragraphs.english: The government's case is stated fairly. Higher density, it argues, can support inclusive economic growth while lowering carbon emissions and reducing dependence on private cars. The new towns programme names seven proposed locations, and the article points to Leeds South Bank, Manchester Victoria North and London Thamesmead as examples of dense urban living planned where transport links and jobs already exist.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章对政府的理由交代得很公允。政府主张，更高的密度可以支撑包容性经济增长，同时降低碳排放、减少对私家车的依赖。新城计划列出了七个候选地点，文章举出利兹南岸、曼彻斯特维多利亚北和伦敦泰晤士米德，作为在已有交通连接和就业机会之处规划高密度城市生活的例子。

paragraphs.english: Wholly new settlements raise the question more sharply. Tempsford, in the Oxford to Cambridge growth corridor, is expected to follow a denser model than the last generation of new towns, but the policy's aim is described only as “ambitious density”. The quotation marks are the authors': the phrase is a direction rather than a specification, and the article uses it to show how much is left to be decided later.
paragraphs.chinese: 完全新建的聚落把问题提得更尖锐。位于牛津至剑桥增长走廊的 Tempsford，预计会采用比上一代新城更紧凑的模式，但政策目标只被表述为“雄心勃勃的密度”。引号是作者加的：这个说法给出的是方向而不是规格，文章借此说明还有多少事情留待日后决定。

paragraphs.english: The article then does something useful with the word density. Density, it points out, does not have to mean tall towers. Barcelona, Paris and Stockholm often consist of six-storey apartment blocks arranged around grids of walkable streets and public squares, and they are significantly denser than comparable British cities. The image corrects an assumption that high density and high-rise are the same thing.
paragraphs.chinese: 接着，文章对“密度”一词做了有用的处理。它指出，密度并不一定意味着高塔。巴塞罗那、巴黎和斯德哥尔摩常常由六层公寓楼构成，围绕可步行的街道网格和公共广场排列，而它们的密度显著高于同等规模的英国城市。这一图景纠正了一种假设：高密度就等于高层建筑。

paragraphs.english: The implication for British housing is concrete. If the policy is serious, it requires a move away from the two-storey estates built around towns and cities in recent decades, and towards mid-rise neighbourhoods of four to eight storeys, close to mixed-use high streets that can be walked. That is a description of a built form, not a slogan, and it is where the argument becomes uncomfortable.
paragraphs.chinese: 这对英国住房的含义很具体。如果政策是认真的，就要求摆脱近几十年在城镇周边建起的二层住宅区，转向四至八层的中层街区，并且靠近可以步行的混合用途商业街。这是对一种建成形态的描述，而不是口号，文章的论证也正是在这里变得不那么舒服。

paragraphs.english: The first obstacle is the industry. Britain's housing system, the authors argue, is not set up to deliver these kinds of neighbourhoods or towns. Most housing is still built at low density, and the large volume housebuilders are highly profitable; there is little appetite within those firms to adapt a business model that works for them.
paragraphs.chinese: 第一个障碍是行业本身。作者认为，英国的住房体系并不是为交付这类街区或城镇而设置的。多数住宅仍以低密度建造，而大型批量开发商利润丰厚；这些企业内部没有多少意愿去改变一套对自己行之有效的商业模式。

paragraphs.english: The second obstacle is cost. Denser schemes can be more complex and more expensive to build. Building safety regulations, together with rising land and material costs, make high-density development less financially attractive than suburban housing. The article does not treat this as an excuse; it treats it as a reason why the promised form will not appear unless policy changes the arithmetic.
paragraphs.chinese: 第二个障碍是成本。更紧凑的方案往往建造起来更复杂、更昂贵。建筑安全法规，加上不断上涨的土地和材料成本，使高密度开发在财务上不如郊区住宅有吸引力。文章没有把这当成借口，而是把它当成一个理由：除非政策改变这笔账，否则承诺的形态不会出现。

paragraphs.english: The third obstacle is preference, and here the article is careful. Research repeatedly finds that people in the UK prefer houses to flats, and proposals for denser development often meet strong local opposition. These are real constraints, but the authors do not present them as fixed. They note that such attitudes are not universal.
paragraphs.chinese: 第三个障碍是偏好，文章在这一点上很谨慎。研究一再发现，英国人更喜欢独栋住宅而不是公寓，而提高密度的方案常常遭遇强烈的地方反对。这些都是真实的约束，但作者并不把它们说成固定不变。他们指出，这类态度并不普遍。

paragraphs.english: In much of Europe there is strong support for compact living across income groups, particularly where good local amenities and accessible green space are part of the package. Even within the UK, the three- to five-storey tenements and apartments common in Scottish cities show that higher density can be both acceptable and desirable. The British preference, in other words, may be a response to what density has usually looked like rather than a permanent fact about British people.
paragraphs.chinese: 在欧洲许多地方，各收入群体都强烈支持紧凑居住，尤其是当良好的本地设施和可达的绿地构成整体方案的一部分时。即便在英国国内，苏格兰城市常见的三至五层联排公寓楼也表明，更高的密度可以既被接受又令人向往。换言之，英国人的偏好也许是对密度通常呈现的样子所作的反应，而不是关于英国人的永久事实。

paragraphs.english: Recent history has made the question harder. The Grenfell Tower fire, and the revelation that thousands of people were living in buildings with the same unsafe cladding, deepened existing anxieties about higher-density urban living. The article records this without turning it into an argument against density; it treats it as part of the political weather that any new towns programme has to survive.
paragraphs.chinese: 近年的历史让问题更难。格林菲尔塔火灾，以及随后曝出成千上万人住在使用同类不安全外墙材料的建筑里，加深了人们对高密度城市生活既有的焦虑。文章记录了这一点，却没有把它变成反对密度的论据；它把这视为任何新城计划都必须挺过的政治气候。

paragraphs.english: Language has become part of the problem. Planning ideas such as the “15-minute city” and low traffic neighbourhoods have become politically polarising, and some critics have characterised them as a government conspiracy to control how people live and move. Once a design idea acquires that kind of meaning, the technical case for it is no longer the whole argument.
paragraphs.chinese: 语言本身也成了问题的一部分。“15 分钟城市”和低交通流量街区等规划理念已在政治上两极分化，一些批评者把它们描述为政府控制人们如何生活与出行的阴谋。一旦一个设计理念获得这层含义，它的技术理由就不再是论证的全部。

paragraphs.english: The article's positive claim is a list of conditions. Dense neighbourhoods that work well, whether in Europe or in parts of the UK, depend on high-quality urban, landscape and architectural design; a mix of tenures, land uses and amenities; and good public transport. These are precisely the ingredients named in the UK's new towns policy. They are also, the authors add, the parts of placemaking that local authorities struggle to deliver and the housebuilding industry actively resists.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章的正面主张是一串条件。运作良好的高密度街区，无论是在欧洲还是英国部分地区，都依赖高质量的城市、景观与建筑设计；依赖产权类型、土地用途与配套设施的混合；也依赖良好的公共交通。这些恰恰是英国新城政策点名的要素。作者补充说，它们也正是地方当局难以交付、住宅建造行业主动抵制的那些“场所营造”环节。

paragraphs.english: That sentence contains the article's real warning. The gap is not between good intentions and bad ones; it is between a policy document and the institutions that would have to carry it out. If planning deregulation leads to higher density being built hastily and without sufficient thought, the result could be crowded places without shops or services, poorly served by public transport.
paragraphs.chinese: 这句话包含了文章真正的警告。缺口不在善意与恶意之间，而在政策文件与必须执行它的机构之间。如果放松规划管制导致更高密度在仓促、缺乏足够考虑的情况下建成，结果可能是拥挤却缺少商店与服务、公共交通覆盖很差的地方。

paragraphs.english: The consequence would be political as well as physical. Badly built density would confirm the fears that already surround the word, and would strengthen local opposition to the next proposal. The article's closing sentence makes the test explicit: the success of the next generation of new towns will depend not just on the number of homes built, but on whether they create denser places that people genuinely want to live in.
paragraphs.chinese: 后果既是物质上的，也是政治上的。建得很糟的高密度会坐实围绕这个词的既有恐惧，并强化地方对下一个方案的反对。文章的收尾句把检验标准说得很明确：新一代新城的成功，不仅取决于建了多少套住房，还取决于它们是否造出了人们真正愿意居住的、更紧凑的地方。

paragraphs.english: For a reader of English, the piece is a good example of how a policy argument is assembled. Notice the pattern: a claim is stated in its strongest form, then qualified by an obstacle, then qualified again by a counter-example. Words such as but, yet, however and even so do the structural work. Remove them and the article would read as a simple attack or a simple defence; with them, it reads as an assessment.
paragraphs.chinese: 对英语读者来说，这篇文章是观察政策论证如何搭建的好例子。注意这个模式：先把主张以最强形式说出，再用一个障碍加以限定，然后用一个反例再次限定。but、yet、however、even so 这类词承担了结构性的工作。把它们删掉，文章读起来会像单纯的攻击或单纯的辩护；有它们，文章才像一份评估。

paragraphs.english: There is also a lesson in what the article does not do. It offers almost no numbers, no cost estimates and no timetable. Its evidence is a set of examples, a policy document and a body of research on preference, and its conclusions are conditional. That is appropriate for a question whose answer depends on decisions not yet taken, but it means the reader should not mistake the article for a prediction.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章“没做什么”也提供了教训。它几乎没有给出数字、成本估算或时间表。它的证据是一组例子、一份政策文件，以及一批关于偏好的研究，结论是有条件的。对于答案取决于尚未作出的决定的问题，这是恰当的；但这也意味着，读者不应把文章误当成预测。

paragraphs.english: Useful vocabulary here is mostly abstract: density, walkability, placemaking, tenure, deregulation, mixed use. Each names a bundle of decisions rather than a single object, and each becomes clearer when you can see which decision the sentence is actually about. The phrase “ambitious density” is a small case study in itself: an adjective doing the work that a number should do.
paragraphs.chinese: 这里有用的词汇大多是抽象的：density（密度）、walkability（可步行性）、placemaking（场所营造）、tenure（产权/持有形式）、deregulation（放松管制）、mixed use（混合用途）。每个词命名的都是一组决定，而不是单一物件；当你能看出句子实际在谈哪一项决定时，每个词都会更清楚。“ambitious density”这个说法本身就是个小案例：一个形容词在做本该由数字来做的事。

paragraphs.english: Here is an editor-written practice sentence, not a quotation from the original article: If a town is built at the density the policy asks for but without the shops, schools and bus routes that make density convenient, it will be judged not by the number of homes it contains but by the cars its residents still need.
paragraphs.chinese: 下面是一句由编辑自拟的练习句，不是原文引句：If a town is built at the density the policy asks for but without the shops, schools and bus routes that make density convenient, it will be judged not by the number of homes it contains but by the cars its residents still need.（如果一个城镇按政策要求的密度建成，却缺少让密度变得便利的商店、学校和公交线路，那么评判它的标准就不会是它有多少套住房，而是居民仍然需要多少辆汽车。）

paragraphs.english: That sentence is also a fair summary of the article's position. The authors are not arguing for or against new towns as such. They are arguing that density is a means whose value depends on everything built alongside it, and that the UK's record suggests the alongside is the hard part.
paragraphs.chinese: 这句话也相当准确地概括了文章的立场。作者并不是在笼统地支持或反对新城。他们主张，密度是一种手段，其价值取决于与之配套建成的一切；而英国过往的记录表明，配套恰恰是困难的部分。

sentenceNotes.sentence: If planning deregulation leads to higher density being built hastily and without sufficient thought, the result could be crowded places without shops or services, poorly served by public transport.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: the result could be crowded places（主句：结果可能是拥挤的地方）
sentenceNotes.structure: If 引导条件状语从句；being built hastily and without sufficient thought 是动名词被动结构作 higher density 的补足语；poorly served by public transport 是过去分词短语后置修饰 places。
sentenceNotes.translation: 如果放松规划管制导致更高密度在仓促、缺乏足够考虑的情况下建成，结果可能是拥挤却缺少商店与服务、公共交通覆盖很差的地方。
sentenceNotes.tip: 注意 could 不是 will：作者给出的是条件性预测。being built 的逻辑主语是 higher density，不是 deregulation；读的时候要把这一层被动关系补出来。

sentenceNotes.sentence: The British preference, in other words, may be a response to what density has usually looked like rather than a permanent fact about British people.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: The British preference may be a response（主语 + 情态动词 + 表语）
sentenceNotes.structure: in other words 是插入语；to what density has usually looked like 是介词 to 加名词性从句作 response 的补足；rather than 连接两个并列成分，否定后者、保留前者。
sentenceNotes.translation: 换言之，英国人的偏好也许是对密度通常呈现的样子所作的反应，而不是关于英国人的永久事实。
sentenceNotes.tip: rather than 在这里不是简单的“而不是”，它承担了论证功能：把“偏好”从本质主义解释拉回到经验解释。may 则保留了作者不愿下断言的余地。

sentenceNotes.sentence: If a town is built at the density the policy asks for but without the shops, schools and bus routes that make density convenient, it will be judged not by the number of homes it contains but by the cars its residents still need.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: it will be judged not by the number of homes ... but by the cars ...（主句为被动结构，含 not by ... but by ... 的对比）
sentenceNotes.structure: If 从句中，the policy asks for 是省略了关系词的定语从句修饰 density；but without ... 与 at the density 形成对照；that make density convenient 修饰 shops, schools and bus routes；两个省略关系词的定语从句 it contains 和 its residents still need 分别修饰 homes 与 cars。
sentenceNotes.translation: 如果一个城镇按政策要求的密度建成，却缺少让密度变得便利的商店、学校和公交线路，那么评判它的标准就不会是它有多少套住房，而是居民仍然需要多少辆汽车。
sentenceNotes.tip: 这是编辑自拟的练习句，不是原文引句。练习重点是把三个省略关系词的定语从句还原出来，并看清 not by ... but by ... 的平行结构。
